Many infants born with neonatal Graves disease are premature and have intrauterine growth restriction.\nMany infants also have goiter, and occasionally tracheal compression can occur if the goiter is very large.
❖ Risk factors are intrauterine growth restriction, especially if accompanied by antenatal\nreversed end diastolic flow on Doppler studies and perinatal asphyxia.
